gameRules.title: How it works
gameRules.p1: The Starting XI ranking is calculated at the end of each matchday. The rating each player receives from the API (out of 10) is multiplied by 10 to give their score — a player rated 7/10 earns 70 points.
gameRules.p2: Your team's score is the sum of your 11 players' scores. Your captain gets a +0.5 bonus on their rating — a captain rated 7/10 earns 75 points instead of 70. Set your captain by tapping the star next to a player while building your team — a "C" badge appears on their photo.
gameRules.p3: If a player doesn't play during the matchday, they automatically receive a rating of 5/10, i.e. 50 points.
gameRules.p4: Once your team is saved, it's locked: tap a player to see their next match (date, time, opponent) instead of changing them. An "Edit team" button remains available to unlock it and make changes until kickoff.
gameRules.p5: As soon as a matchday's match ends, the player's rating appears in a small circle at the bottom right of their photo — dark red near 0/10, orange at 5/10, light green at 7/10, dark green near 10/10.
gameRules.p6: Saving your team also activates notifications for your 11 players: starting or not at kickoff, goal, assist, card, and full-time rating. If you're already preparing next matchday's team in advance, its notifications stay pending and activate automatically once that matchday starts — no need to reopen the app.
